whatIDo: I am currently a Master's student in Spatial Data Science at the University of Southern California. I earned my Bachelor's degree in Data Science and Big Data Technology from Minzu University of China.

My research centers on developing trustworthy and interpretable AI systems. I study the internal mechanisms of large language models and how they interact with human-designed tasks, and I explore their use in real-world settings such as coding and geo-spatial analysis.
By blending strong theoretical foundations with real-world applications, I aim to make AI not only smarter but also more understandable and impactful in practical settings.
